title: Quinnen Williams gets massive $105.9 million Cowboys contract extension less than a year after blockbuster Jets trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Quinnen Williams gets massive $105.9 million Cowboys contract extension less than a year after blockbuster Jets trade
sources.description: The ex-Jets star agreed to a three-year, $105.9 million contract extension, with $101 million total guaranteed, making him one of the highest-paid defensive linemen in the league.
